sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("center-pixel 8x6 grid:")
for aa in range(8):
    print(aa,[a[6*aa+10][6*bb+16] for bb in range(6)])
# probe: move RIGHT from (4,0) into white (4,1)
def find_player(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0>=4 and c1-c0>=4:
                return (r0,c0)
print("player before:",find_player(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
print("player after RIGHT:",find_player(current_frame))
print("result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def find_player(frame):
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            if r1-r0>=4 and c1-c0>=4:

print("player before:",find_player(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT'])
